title: House Robber IV
description:
A robber must choose at least `k` nonadjacent houses. The capability of a chosen set is the largest amount in any chosen house. Given `nums` and `k`, return the minimum capability possible.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [2,3,5,9], k = 2
Output: 5
```

```text
Input: nums = [2,7,9,3,1], k = 2
Output: 2
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9`
- `1 <= k <= (nums.length + 1) // 2`
